law: signal-event counting ONLY (entries, exits, hold times, funding-boundary exposures); NO per-trade returns/equity exists in this lane (plan §7.3/§11)

cost_stack.tier_law: multiplier applies to the FULL stack (fees+slippage+funding)

execution: decision at H4 close, fill at NEXT H4 bucket open, no mid-bar fills

churn_sanity.noop_law: same-direction label noise inside the gate buffer cannot fill: exit requires exit_buffer consecutive non-phase bars; re-entry requires a fresh entry event

ceiling.law: cadence x frozen cost stack vs PLAUSIBLE_EDGE_BPS bound; no strategy returns used
ceiling.margin_note: candidate survives the ceiling if its frozen cadence keeps 1.5x per-trade cost below the preregistered plausible-edge bound; actual edge is measured only post-GO in the scored run
